purpose: Teach: 飛行場/プロパティ/アダルト/宇宙船/エルサレム/ミュンヘン/インスタント/イタリアン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、飛行場に父さん見送りに行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku—did you go see your dad off at the airport?
lines.style: Light, direct interrogation. Playful tilt on the question. Eyes narrowed but not unkind. Catching him in something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、CSS のプロパティ、もう覚えたか?桜
lines.en: You already memorized CSS properties, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question of his own. Casual, slightly defensive. Slower pace—buying time to think. No real interest in the answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アダルトサイトには絶対近づくなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't you dare go anywhere near adult sites. I mean it.
lines.style: Sharp, firm opening. Dropped register—serious for a moment. One step closer. The tone of someone who's had to say this before.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宇宙船の映画、見たろ?桜
lines.en: You seen that movie with the spaceship in it, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting again. Softer this time—almost gentle. Rhythmic, like he's reciting something he rehearsed. Eyes slightly away.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、世界史でエルサレムの単元、覚えてるか?
lines.en: Riku, do you remember the Jerusalem unit from world history?
lines.style: Resuming the interrogation. Brighter attack. Testing whether he's paying attention to things outside whatever he's hiding. Quick pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ミュンヘンオリンピックの話、知ってる?桜
lines.en: You know about the Munich Olympics incident, Sakura?
lines.style: Serious, genuine question buried under casualness. Slower. Reaching for something real but keeping it masked. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、インスタントカップ麺、よく食べてんな
lines.en: Riku, you're really going through instant ramen like it's going out of style.
lines.style: Teasing observation. Warm undertone beneath the wry surface. Almost affectionate. A small laugh behind the words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、イタリアンレストランに彼女連れてったろ?桜
lines.en: So you took your girlfriend to that Italian place, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gotcha energy. Playful but with a sharper edge underneath. Leaning on the teasing—he's found something. Quick tempo, slight smirk in the voice.
